mapper.sql:
SELECT seq , mb_id , title , file_no , file_url , writer_nm , DATE_FORMAT(in_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS in_dtm , DATE_FORMAT(up_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS up_dtm FROM tbts_image_board WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND use_yn = 'Y'
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_word}, '%')
mapper.select:
/* imageboard-mapper.xml id="selectImageBoardList" 이미지게시판 목록 조회(페이징) */
ORDER BY seq DESC

/* imageboard-mapper.xml id="selectImageBoardView" 이미지게시판 단건 조회 */ SELECT seq , mb_id , title , file_no , file_url , writer_nm , DATE_FORMAT(in_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS in_dtm , DATE_FORMAT(up_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS up_dtm FROM tbts_image_board WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND seq = #{seq} AND use_yn = 'Y'
